## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that causes existing behaviour to change)
- [ ] Refactor (no functional change)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test / CI

## Testing

<!-- How did you verify this works? -->

- [ ] `npm run test` passes
- [ ] `npm run test:frontend` passes (if frontend touched)
- [ ] `.venv/bin/python -m pytest python/` passes (if Python bridge touched)
- [ ] Manual testing: <!-- describe -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow the conventional commits format (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, etc.)
- [ ] I have read the [CLA](../CLA.md) and agree to its terms
- [ ] If this adds a new Python dependency, I have added it to `python/requirements.txt`
- [ ] If this changes the plugin API, I have updated `docs/plugins/` (lifecycle, ui, backend, frontend, or testing)
- [ ] If this changes security-relevant code, I have flagged it in the summary
